design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. An authoritative 'Control Room' for Zimbabwean AML compliance officers. Priority is data density, high-contrast alerts, and zero visual fluff.

spacing_and_layout.surface_style: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use visible structural borders to separate widgets instead of floating soft cards.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-800 text-white hover:bg-blue-900 rounded-sm font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-700 rounded-sm font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-sm transition-colors

badges.risk_high: bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 font-mono text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm uppercase
badges.risk_medium: bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 font-mono text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm uppercase
badges.risk_low: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 font-mono text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm uppercase

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-slate-200
tables.cell: py-3 px-4 text-sm text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-100 font-mono

forms.input: border border-slate-300 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-800 focus:border-blue-800 focus:outline-none transition-all
forms.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-1 block

graph_network_visualization.rationale: 2D provides better analytical clarity for compliance officers than 3D. 3D can obscure layering chains.
graph_network_visualization.styling: Nodes representing accounts should be solid circles. Suspect nodes in Signal Red (#E11D48), Bank nodes in Klein Blue (#002FA7). Edges representing transactions should be gray (#CBD5E1) with directional arrows, thickness representing transaction volume.

nlp_analysis.styling: Text blocks showing transaction descriptions should use 'IBM Plex Mono'. Suspicious keywords (e.g., 'urgent', 'loan repayment', 'offshore') should be highlighted with a pale red background (#FFE4E6) and dark red text (#9F1239).

alerts_feed.styling: A dense, scrolling list of alerts. Use a subtle pulse animation (animate-pulse) on the left border of unread High-Risk alerts.

media_and_icons.icon_rationale: Phosphor Icons provide a dense, professional look ideal for data-heavy RegTech tools.

login_background.description: Harare skyline to ground the app in its Zimbabwean context. Use with a heavy white overlay (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) on the login screen to maintain high contrast for the login card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using a strict grid system (e.g., grid-cols-12). Avoid soft, floating cards; use border-collapse styles where items touch, or tight gaps with sharp 1px borders.
Data density is critical. Do not waste space. Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for all numerical data, transaction IDs, and timestamps to ensure vertical alignment in tables.
For the Network Graph, integrate 'react-force-graph-2d'. Make it central to the investigation view. Add controls to filter by Bank (CBZ, Stanbic, etc.) or Mobile Money (EcoCash, InnBucks).
The Deep Learning Risk Score should be highly visible as a gauge or progress bar, using the strict Red/Yellow/Green status colors.
For the NLP Panel, display transaction narratives as raw text strings but visually highlight flagged keywords (e.g., 'loan repayment').
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) to ensure a precise, technical look.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="alert-resolve-button"').
Avoid purples or teals. Stick to the Swiss high-contrast palette: Stark White, Slate Gray, Klein Blue, Signal Red.
File extensions should be .js and .jsx, as the project uses JavaScript.
